primary_hypotheses.text: Compared with scalar-score / replay-only / average-improvement acceptance, protected Pareto admission produces a higher rate of changes that remain beneficial under independent cross-domain fresh evaluation, with fewer hidden regressions.
Immutable negative-history retrieval reduces repeated regression classes.
Protected non-regression constraints do not collapse to total refusal.
The Pareto set retains useful diversity rather than converging to one overly conservative solution.

statistics.cannot_check: A CANNOT_CHECK result on a dimension declared mandatory for the candidate class blocks admission. It is never recoded as 0 or PASS.
statistics.interval: Per-dimension effects and intervals are reported separately. No mean global score is a decision input.
statistics.multiplicity: All frozen dimensions must pass. Selecting a flattering subset of objectives after outcomes is forbidden.
statistics.non_inferiority: higher_better: delta >= -margin; lower_better: delta <= margin; fail_closed: PASS or block.
statistics.sequential: Adaptive candidate arrival reuses this freeze. Weights and margins are not updated after any candidate outcome.
statistics.unit: one candidate change evaluated on the frozen family portfolio
statistics.worst_family: Safety and non-regression decisions use the worst family on that dimension. Family means are not authority.
